title: Cauliflower Shawarma
subtitle: in pita with tahini and amba
description: Thinly sliced cauliflower fried with onion and shawarma spices until soft and golden. Serve in pita, a baguette or on a plate with plenty of tahini and amba.

steps.text: Break the cauliflower into florets and cut them into relatively thin slices. Thinly slice the onions.
Heat the oil in a frying pan and fry the onion with the cauliflower until the cauliflower softens and turns golden. Add half a cup of boiling water to help the cauliflower soften.
Add the dry spices, stir, taste and adjust the seasoning if needed.
Assemble in pita, lafa, ciabatta or on a plate, with plenty of tahini and amba.
